title: South Korea surpasses US$1 trillion in annual exports, powered by AI
html:
On November 19, South Korea officially surpassed US$1 trillion in annual exports. With this achievement, South Korea becomes only the fourth nation in history to join the US$1 trillion export club, following Germany, the United States, and China.

Credit: Reuters
